# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is described as having a tendency to turn as red as a beetroot when caught or embarrassed. She is also noted for her weight, being described as heavy compared to other girls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is dishonest, spiteful, and prone to mocking others, particularly regarding their appearance or misfortunes. She exhibits vanity about her skills, such as walking wooden fences or handiwork, while holding a sarcastic attitude toward her peers' achievements. Despite her haughty demeanor, she is quick to panic when faced with danger or the consequences of her actions.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P8](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0008), [v1 c23 P14](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0014), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c24 P13](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0013), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)_

- Balancing along wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c23 P8](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To lead her class academically  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- To gain an education rather than earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flossie attends Brierley school, where she is caught cheating by looking at her book during a spelling class. Later, she mocks Nell Harcourt during class, leading Nell to break a slate over Hugh Carrow's head. At Mr. Pembroke's garden party, Flossie boasts of her fence-walking skills and dares Nell to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, which results in Nell falling and spraining her ankle. During Nell's recovery, Flossie visits her out of apparent regret. She later joins the Regent's entrance class under Miss Thorne, though she refuses to participate in a school concert dialogue after failing to secure the role of the Fairy Queen. She eventually passes the entrance examination and attends Regent's Academy in Portmaris.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
